target_customer: Egyptian consumers and small businesses buying motor, health and other insurance online
problem: Insurance in Egypt is slow and opaque with very low penetration. Amenli is a licensed online broker that issues policies in minutes.

founders.name: Shady El Tohfa
prior_employers: Skydeck at UC Berkeley (Entrepreneur in Residence)
education: American University in Cairo, B.A. Business Administration

founders.name: Omar Ezz El-Din
founders.background_notes: Named as a founder by Wamda (October 2021) but not on the YC page.

competitors.name: Amanleek
competitors.what: Egyptian insurtech reported as the first to secure a digital brokering license

technical_complexity.rationale: Quote and policy issuance integrations with local insurers are standard software; the hard part is licensing and insurer partnerships.

defensibility.rationale: A broker license and insurer relationships were scarce in Egypt when it launched; the software itself was copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying it; Amenli continued to raise through 2024 and EBRD documents show a further financing in 2025.

market_need_then: Egypt had one of the world's lowest insurance penetrations on a 100 million population (company statement), with policies taking about three weeks traditionally.

brand_strength.rationale: Trust-oriented positioning but no press or community evidence about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Amenli, founded by two early Paymob team members, was the first licensed online insurance broker in Egypt and raised a $2.3M seed in October 2021, $1M in 2023 and $2.3M in 2024 with EBRD and YC. Team size of 65 and continued rounds suggest steady growth, though no revenue data was found and no exit has occurred.
notes: Wamda's seed headline says $2 million, body and TechCrunch say $2.3M. Stage of the 2023 and 2024 rounds is not stated by sources so recorded as other. An EBRD disclosure (Oct 2025) describes up to $2M equity in pre-series A preferred shares of a Singapore entity as part of a $3M round; not recorded as a round because the close was not confirmed. The 2024 EBRD round and 2025 EBRD disclosure may be the same financing. Competitor source is October 2021, a few months after the batch.
